package.name: lio_localization
package.description: Prior-map localization for FAST-LIO: a ROS 2 C++/PCL port of HViktorTsoi/FAST_LIO_LOCALIZATION, adapted to this repo's FAST-LIO frame contract (map -> odom -> base_footprint). global_localization registers FAST-LIO's /cloud_registered against a saved .pcd map via PCL ICP and publishes the map->odom correction; transform_fusion broadcasts it as TF at high rate. No Open3D dependency. Replaces the runtime pgo_map_odom_bridge for localization runs.
